messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy completed: release/2026.03.22-rc3 (c4b2a) -> prod/us-east-2. Canary: 5% (staggered). Kicking off post-deploy smoke + synth checks.

Lena: FYI synthetic probe for /v1/embeddings (us-east-2) p95 jumped from ~210ms to ~820ms within the last 3 minutes. Small number of 502s interleaved. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/obs/canary/2791000000 cc @Omar

Omar: Any correlation with request size or batching?

Maya: Quick split looks like both short and long prompts hit the tail. Not just long sequences.

Chen: I pulled the canary logs. A couple of proxy 502s, then a cascade of retries that amplified tail. Excerpt: 
```
[2026-03-22T21:40:12Z] proxy: upstream error 502 seq_len=64 trace_id=tx-9b2a
[2026-03-22T21:40:13Z] worker: kv-cache-miss, load model shard 0/3
[2026-03-22T21:40:14Z] runtime: batch wait 120ms -> processing
[2026-03-22T21:40:15Z] proxy: retry limit reached -> 502
```

oncall-sre: Are hosts GCing or swapping? Any node-level pressure?

infra-bot: infra-bot: host metrics for canary pool (us-east-2): CPU load normal, small IO spike on /dev/nvme1 around 21:40, no OOMs recorded. Telemetry: https://internal.redwood/infra/2791000000

Lena: Given tail + early 502s, I recommend we pause the canary advance and pin the embeddings route in us-east-2 to the previous modelvariant `embed-stable-20260318` while we triage. Pin should be safe and quick.

Omar: +1. Pin first, then run AB rerun of synths against pinned variant. If pinned traffic restores p95 then keep paused and investigate batching/regeneration in the new runtime. If pin doesn't help, revert.

Maya: I'll apply pin and enable a temporary circuit-breaker: if 5xx > 0.5% for 2m -> divert to cpu-fallback. Running: 
```
rbctl pin-route --region=us-east-2 --service=embeddings --to=model:embed-stable-20260318 --reason="postdeploy embed p95 spike" --duration=60m
rbctl set-fallback --region=us-east-2 --service=embeddings --threshold=0.5 --window=120s --fallback=cpu-fallback
```

infra-bot: infra-bot: route pin applied by Maya at 2791000025. Fallback policy updated. Observability: https://internal.redwood/obs/canary/2791000000

Chen: Ran quick A/B (500 reqs each) against pinned variant vs canary: pinned p95=225ms, canary p95=810ms. No 502s reproduced in A/B.

Lena: Good. Pausing rollout at 5% in us-east-2. Watch window 45m. Setting alert: p95(embeddings,us-east-2) > 400ms for 5m -> page.

oncall-sre: Agreed. Also add an automated rollback rule: if 5xx > 1% AND p95 > 600ms for 5m -> auto-revert to release/2026.03.20 and page primary oncall.

Maya: Release notes updated: "us-east-2: canary paused at 5% for embeddings due to p95 tail; route pinned to embed-stable-20260318; fallback configured; watch 45m."

Omar: I'll start a focused triage on batching and model shard-load timing. Chen, can you collect deferred spans and KV cache hit/miss stats for the canary pool?

Chen: On it. Posting artifacts to INF-6750.

deploy-bot: Canary paused at 5% for region=us-east-2 by operator action. To continue: `deploy resume --region=us-east-2 --percent=15`. To revert: `deploy revert --to=release/2026.03.20`.

Lena: Thanks team. Will reconvene with findings or earlier if alerts fire. :eyes:
